prompt: Which arrangement would meet Irene’s cousin’s request?
promptZh: 哪項安排能符合艾琳表親的需求？

options.text: Have her borrow a route map after the day’s guided session and take it home.
options.zh: 在當天有導覽的場次結束後，借她一張路線圖帶回家。
options.whyZh: 這項安排沒有提供她想要的無口頭解說現場體驗；而且每場結束後，路線圖須收到指定抽屜，不能借回家。

options.text: Leave a pocket card for her to take away after a short spoken introduction.
options.zh: 在簡短的口頭介紹後，留一張口袋卡給她帶走。
options.whyZh: 口頭介紹不符合她需要的無解說環境，口袋卡也沒有路線。

options.text: Let her follow the full map at a quiet session and return it before she leaves.
options.zh: 讓她在靜音場次摸讀完整地圖，離開前歸還。
options.whyZh: 靜音場次既無口頭介紹，又提供完整路線圖；當場使用並歸還即可。

options.text: Give her a pocket card at the quiet session in place of the full map.
options.zh: 在靜音場次用口袋卡代替完整地圖交給她。
options.whyZh: 靜音場次符合環境需求，但口袋卡只有圖例，不能讓她摸讀完整路線。

explanationZh: 靜音場次既無口頭介紹，又提供完整路線圖；當場使用並歸還即可。

vocabulary.note: quiet session 提供完整地圖且不使用口頭解說，和能帶走的圖例卡用途不同。

evidence: The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not. / The pocket card is a raised version of the key, with the route names in large print. Visitors may take it away, but it does not show the routes themselves. At a quiet session, visitors can follow the complete routes on their own, without spoken directions or commentary. In a quiet session, visitors still need to return the route maps before leaving. / Irene will bring her cousin on Friday. Her cousin wants to explore an entire route independently and needs the room to be free of narration, but does not need a map to take away. The pocket cards for mailing are already packed. Please keep her on the guest list, even if preparing the quiet session adds work.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The route kit contains raised maps that visitors can follow under a guide’s direction. Mount the maps on a portable floor stand (not on a countertop) unless the venue has a fixed mount. After a session, the maps must go into a flat, lockable drawer. A spare stand travels with every kit; storage does not.

The pocket card is a raised version of the key, with the route names in large print. Visitors may take it away, but it does not show the routes themselves. At a quiet session, visitors can follow the complete routes on their own, without spoken directions or commentary. In a quiet session, visitors still need to return the route maps before leaving.

Irene will bring her cousin on Friday. Her cousin wants to explore an entire route independently and needs the room to be free of narration, but does not need a map to take away. The pocket cards for mailing are already packed. Please keep her on the guest list, even if preparing the quiet session adds work.
